missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Воздух' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Свежий' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'очень' intensifies the description.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Воздух' is the accusative direct object of 'впусти'. As an inanimate masculine noun it keeps the same form. 'Открой окно' sets up the action.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Воздуха' is the genitive of 'воздух', required after 'нет'. 'Загрязнённого' agrees in the masculine genitive, marking absence.
Strategic focus: Genitive of quantity. 'Воздуха' is the genitive of 'воздух' after 'много'. 'Чистого' agrees in the masculine genitive, and 'растениям' is the dative of need.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Воздухом' is the masculine instrumental of 'воздух', required by 'дышим'. 'Свежим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Воздухе' is the prepositional of 'воздух' in the fixed phrase 'на свежем воздухе', meaning outdoors. 'Свежем' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Воздух' is the masculine nominative subject of 'поднимается'. 'Тёплый' agrees in the masculine nominative, and 'вверх' gives direction.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Воздухе' is the prepositional of 'воздух' after 'в'. 'Высоко' adds height, and 'птицы' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative with predicate instrumental. 'Воздух' is the nominative subject of 'стал'. 'Душным' is the instrumental predicate adjective, and 'в комнате' gives the location.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject with dative experiencer. 'Воздух' is the nominative subject of 'нравится'. 'Горный' agrees in the masculine nominative, 'мне' is the dative experiencer, and 'весной' is an instrumental of time.
